verdicts.quote: as a care coordinator, I want to see a clear indicator of which notes are urgent or require immediate action — like a red tag for new assessments, medication changes, or falls
if a note is missing, I want it to be obvious — not just a blank row, but a red highlight with the patient’s name and the time it was due

when a nurse saves a ward note in InHealth, the system must immediately confirm the note was sent to ShareSheet, with a clear message on screen. If the send fails, the system must retry automatically every 5 minutes for 30 minutes...

The system should keep both copies — but only if they’re entered at different times. It should show both in ShareSheet, but with timestamps and a note that says “Duplicate entry — check for accuracy.”

the status line must update in real time, without needing a refresh. If the connection comes back after 12 minutes, the nurse should see “Sent” appear automatically on the same screen, right after the “Retrying” message.

The alert stays visible on the screen, but now with a “Marked as resolved” button if they click it after entering the note. If the note is already entered, the system shows it as “Note re-entered — check for accuracy”

At 10:15 a.m., the team leader should see a clear alert in their dashboard with the nurse’s name, the patient’s full name, the note type, the time it was due — all in one line, easy to read... Alert stays visible with 'Marked as resolved' button until sync confirmed... If sync fails after 5 minutes post resolution, alert reverts to red and IT is notified
